Figma

Agree on the experience before writing the code.

FOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Figma gives product, marketing, and engineering teams a shared place to design interfaces and review the customer journey. We can turn a business brief into responsive pages, reusable components, interactive prototypes, and a documented design system. The practical output is a clearer specification for development, including content hierarchy, key states, and decisions that stakeholders can review.

Useful outputs

  • Responsive editable page designs
  • Reusable component library and states
  • Reviewable prototype and handoff notes

Where we can apply it

  • Service website: business brief → page hierarchy → desktop and mobile prototype.
  • SaaS onboarding: user goals → interactive flow → developer handoff.
  • Internal tool: operator tasks → approval states → usability review.
01

Use case 1

Design service websites with consistent layouts, typography, and responsive behavior.

02

Use case 2

Prototype onboarding, checkout, lead capture, and internal approvals before development.

03

Use case 3

Create reusable components and design tokens that keep future releases visually coherent.

Inputs we need

  • Brand guidelines and approved content
  • Customer journeys and priority tasks
  • Device requirements and accessibility goals

Delivery sequence

  • Map the information architecture and principal customer tasks.
  • Design components and test the important interaction states.
  • Review the prototype, resolve feedback, and prepare development guidance.

Expert review points

  • Approve final brand assets and page content.
  • Check task completion and responsive behavior with representative users.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Development handoff
  • Design systems
  • Figma plugins

Signals we can make visible

  • Task success rate
  • Prototype completion rate
  • Usability issues resolved

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
